title: Account activity stream events
description: The format of every event in the stream (the `value` of each message on the `accounts` and `transactions` topics). Every event matches this schema and its values are already correct, so you don't need to validate them.

Timestamp.description: A date and time in UTC, ending in Z, e.g. 2026-03-03T14:05:00Z.

Money.description: An amount in US dollars: a JSON number with at most two decimal places.

event_id.description: An ID the sending system attaches to the event.

published_at.description: When the sending system sent this message. Never earlier than occurred_at, and sometimes much later. Don't rely on it for ordering.

event_id.description: An ID the sending system attaches to the event.

occurred_at.description: When the transaction happened. Always the same as data.timestamp.

published_at.description: When the sending system sent this message. Never earlier than occurred_at, and sometimes much later. Don't rely on it for ordering.

account_type.description: The kind of account. It doesn't change how balances are calculated.

starting_balance.description: The account's balance when it was opened, before any transactions.

account_id.description: The account this transaction belongs to. That account is opened somewhere in the stream.

amount.description: Always positive. Whether it adds to or subtracts from the balance is given by `type`.

type.description: DEPOSIT: money into the account, so add `amount` to the balance. WITHDRAWAL: money out of the account, so subtract it.
